dialogues.content: Hey, stop it! Or I'll have to pull out my secret weapon... Alright, you asked for this — HELP! AAHHH!!!
Thank you, I'm safe now! On to more adventures!
That was the last of them. All clear.

nodes.name: 探险白与狩月人的旁白

dialogues.content: I'll go check if there are any more enemies nearby. Be careful on your own.
Got it! I'll stay sharp!
Aww, you're here too... *sob*... I can't believe so many people are willing to help me. Here's a little something for your trouble. Thanks, everyone! You guys are the best!

name: Explorer in Peril!
desc: Defeat the enemies to protect Lunoxplorer

dialogues.content: Hey, stop it! Or I'll have to pull out my secret weapon... Alright, you asked for this — HELP! AAHHH!!!

name: Salvage Operation
desc: Search for useful items in the barrels scattered along the coast

dialogues.content: (Barrels washed ashore line the beach. Maybe they hold something useful.)
(This barrel has a gaping hole in the bottom. Whatever treasure it once held is long gone. Better try another.)
(Nothing but rotten fish and shrimp in this one. Better try another.)
(Patience pays off. After a meticulous search, you spot a hidden compartment — and inside, a stash of usable supplies.)

name: Save the Environment
desc: Clear the weeds in the vicinity

dialogues.content: (Overgrown weeds have swallowed the traces of the memories you once shared here with Berry. Perhaps it's time to clear the shrine's surroundings.)
(The weeds are gone. The shrine stands pristine once more — just as you remember it.)
(Filthoids incoming! Dispel them!)
Meow...
(A stray cat meows forlornly, as if hoping to catch the attention of a kind-hearted passer-by.)
Hello, do you sell cat food here?
No. We're barely managing to feed people, let alone pets.
Excuse me, do you sell cat food here?
Yes, take your pick. This is rare. I thought only the wealthy folks from the inner city buy cat food for their pets.
(The cat bounds away but pauses and glances back at you, as if urging you to follow.)
(The cat bounds away but pauses and glances back at you, as if urging you to follow.)
(Put down some cat food)
(The cat circles the food warily before eventually lowering its guard and digging in. Watching it eat fills your heart with a sense of peace and joy.)
(The cat bounds away but pauses and glances back at you, as if urging you to follow.)
(The cat circles around your feet, obviously happy and content. A warm sense of peace and joy fills your heart.)
Oof... Looks like I'll be working overtime again. Here, take my key and shut off the main Phoxichor valve while I grab my tools.
Dang it! Just a few more to go, and now this.
What happened?
I was checking the condition of the Phoxichor pipes that connect the city.
I've only got a few left, but my safety rope just snapped. Could you go check the rest of the pipes for me?

options.content: Sorry, I'm a bit tied up right now.

dialogues.content: I've marked the remaining pipes for you. I'm counting on you!
(This pipe's in good shape. Let's go check the next one.)
(This pipe's in good shape. Let's go check the next one.)
All good? That's great news! Thank you so much!
(The last one looks good too. Time to go back and inform the fitter.)
(This pipe has been slightly damaged. Better inform the fitter.)
Thank you. I'll take it from here.
(The children cheer excitedly and vanish around the corner in the blink of an eye. Time to find them!)
Alright, you win. Here's your prize. Come play with us again sometime!
Wow, that was quick!
You're really good at this!
Ugh, can't believe I lost...
Wow, that was quick!
You're really good at this!
Ugh, can't believe I lost...
Hide and seek! Come and play hide and seek!
Hide and seek! Come and play hide and seek!
I'm in! But I don't want to be the seeker, I want to hide!
Me too! I've found a super secret spot. I'm sure to win this time!
But we need a seeker... Anyone else up for a game with us?
(The kids notice you passing by, their eyes wide with hope, eagerly waiting for your response.)
Wow, that was quick!
You're really good at this!
Ugh, can't believe I lost...
(A brand-new vehicle sits unattended. Could this be... a golden opportunity?)
What do you think you're doing!? Guys, I need support!
(With no one left to stop you, you pry open the door, grab the Phoxichor Canister, and walk away with a small fortune. Everything's going smooth. What a lucky day.)
Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I'll send more patrols right away. Please accept this small gift as a gesture of gratitude from us.
(Your better angels prevail. You decide to report the security lapse to the guards at the city gate.)

nodes.name: 发现汽车选择是否偷车

dialogues.content: (The car's got a full canister of Phoxichor — jackpot!)

name: Emergency Repairs
desc: Help the distressed soldier with repairs

nodes.name: 士兵对着卡住的机关开车对话

dialogues.content: Ugh... not this again.
What happened?
I can't seem to get this machine working properly. Why don't you give it a try? Let's see if it's the machine or just me.
Um... are you sure a smack would work?
Wait, did a part just fly off?
That actually worked?
Wow, you've got the magic touch!
Thank you.
Impressive! Looks like I'm the problem then...

name: Lost and Found
desc: Retrieve the lost items for the forgetful Phoxhunter

dialogues.content: So many Filthoids... What am I going to do...?
What's wrong?
Wow, judging by your gear, you must be a really skilled Phoxhunter, right? Actually... I'm a Phoxhunter myself, but I'm not very strong...
Could you help me retrieve my weapon from those Filthoids? If I don't get it back, I won't be able to take on my next commission...
...Sure, I'll help you out.
Thank you so much!
They're just up ahead. Be careful!
*sob* If I can't take it back, how am I supposed to make a living...? I haven't had a proper meal in days...

options.content: (Need some time to mull it over)

dialogues.content: Thank you! I'm off to my next commission. Take care!
Thank you! I'm off to my next commission. Take care!

I know the whole story. Are you sure it's a good idea to give her the weapon back? With her strength, she might just die on her next commission. So, why not sell the weapon to me? It's the safer option for everyone.

options.content: (Need some time to mull it over)

dialogues.content: Thank you! Looking forward to our next deal!
Thank you! Looking forward to our next deal!

name: Wheeling and Dealing
desc: Sell the Borealberries at a good price

dialogues.content: (You catch the fragrant aroma of Borealberries from afar. If you pick some, you could make a small fortune.)
(You notice two traders nearby looking to buy Borealberries. Maybe it's worth talking to them both before deciding who to sell to.)
(These Borealberries are vibrant and plump. It's clear these seasonal delights will fetch a good price anywhere.)
I've been running this little stall in Icelake for years. Just a small business — it makes more friends than money. I mean, we can look out for each other in this city, am I right?

options.content: (Need some time to mull it over)

dialogues.content: (Prioritising long-term connections, you make the deal with the local trader despite the lower profit.)
Hey there, I see you've got some Borealberries. I can pay way more than those penny-pinching local traders. How about we make some serious cash together, huh?

options.content: (Need some time to mull it over)

dialogues.content: (Promises of future benefits aren't as reliable as immediate gains. You make the deal with the out-of-town trader and walk away with a hefty sum.)

name: Lunoxplorer's Small Request
desc: Protect Lunoxplorer and defeat the enemies

dialogues.content: Oh, hey! Isn't that {nickname}? Come here!
I've got some serious research to do here. Can you protect me while I work?
Oh... Well, if you won't stick around, I'd better leave. This place gives me the creeps...
I couldn't have done it without you! Here's a little something for your trouble~ Let's team up again next time!
Why do baddies always show up when I'm in the middle of research? I'm counting on you! I'm just getting to the bottom of it.
That's a wrap! Research successfully complete! Hooray!
Let's see... Hmm... Huh... Almost there! Hang in there!

name: Aggressive Patrol
desc: Patrol with the cranky old man

dialogues.content: Come on, sir — it's not that deep. You're reading too much into it.
Reading too much? You lot can't see the danger crawling right under your noses! Icelake's done for with your lot in charge!
Easy, sir. Is there something I can help you with?
Criminals — swarming out of the cracks, I tell you! Tch — kids these days, all spineless!
If the lazy pups at the Security Bureau won't act, then I will! And you — {性别:lad|lass} — you look sharp. Feel like lending an old soldier a hand?
Now!
Ha! The rats are out of hiding! Told you — Icelake's never been safe! Time for these old bones to dish out some justice!
(Before you can stop him, the old man charges straight in. You'd better follow — before this turns into a bloodbath.)
Hmph. Figures. Should've known better than to count on anyone. Off with you, then.
Hmph...
Now!
Ha! The rats are out of hiding! Told you — Icelake's never been safe! Time for these old bones to dish out some justice!
(Before you can stop him, the old man charges straight in. You'd better follow — before this turns into a bloodbath.)
You did good, kid. The safety of Icelake rests on shoulders like ours.
Tch...
Now!
Ha! The rats are out of hiding! Told you — Icelake's never been safe! Time for these old bones to dish out some justice!
(Before you can stop him, the old man charges straight in. You'd better follow — before this turns into a bloodbath.)
Hmph, sneaky little devils... But I'm not done. This city needs justice — and I won't stop till it gets it. You lot better watch your backs...
(Filthoids incoming! Dispel them!)
Jerry! Where did you run off to again...? *sniffles*
Could you help me look for my <H>cat</>? He should still be around here somewhere...
Thank you! Oh, Jerry... please be okay...
(You soon spot a small cat curled up on the ground, trembling. He looks terrified of human contact.)
(You soon spot a small cat curled up on the ground, trembling. He looks terrified of human contact.)
(You soon spot a small cat curled up on the ground, trembling. He looks terrified of human contact.)
Berry, I...
Berry, I...
(You soon spot a small cat curled up on the ground, trembling. He looks terrified of human contact.)
Oh, Jerry, there you are! Thank you so much!
(The girl scoops Jerry into her arms and buries him in kisses. You try not to notice the poor thing wriggling in panic as you quietly accept your reward and slip away.)
You couldn't find him either...? Tch, whatever. I don't want a scruffy stray to be my Jerry anyway. I'll just have Mum get me a better cat — even cuter and well-behaved!
(Filthoids incoming! Dispel them!)
Hey, {nickname}! Come quick — I've found something amazing! A brand new research subject!
The material I need is way across the lake. Would you mind helping me grab some?
Oh... I see. Well, I guess that's lesson number one for any great alchemist — gather your own materials! Got it!
This should be what Theo's looking for. Time to bring it back.
Thank you! To become a great alchemist, there's still sooo much I've got to learn... But I'll get there!

name: A Misunderstanding
desc: Safely deliver supplies to the designated place

dialogues.content: {nickname}! Thank goodness you're here! I need your help!
I was supposed to deliver this crate of supplies to my colleagues across the Lamenting Lake, but I've suddenly got this terrible stomachache. Could you deliver it for me? Please, I'm begging you!
Hello, Kevin asked me to bring these supplies to you.
Wait a minute... The crate is missing two clips and a rifle. You took them, didn't you?
Whoa! I was in the bathroom for a minute, and you're already at each other's throats!
They started it.
Look what this crook did — even had the nerve to steal legion supplies!
Huh? Oh, you mean two clips and a rifle? That's on me. I already took my share earlier.
You're unbelievable! How could you just hand over legion supplies to a random stranger? {性别:He|She} could've been one of The Forsakens!
Ah, sorry, my bad! Lesson learned — won't happen again!
Here, {nickname}. Take this as an apology. Sorry for dragging you into this mess.
I'm back!
Huh? Missing supplies? Oh, you mean two clips and a rifle, right? That's on me. I already took my share earlier.
You're unbelievable! How could you just hand over legion supplies to a random stranger? {性别:He|She} could've been one of The Forsakens!
Ah, sorry, my bad! Lesson learned — won't happen again!
Here, {nickname}. Take this as an apology. Sorry for dragging you into this mess.
Trying to stall and slip away, huh? Everyone, keep a close eye on this kid. Don't let {性别:him|her} get away.
Embezzling imperial property is a serious offence. You're coming with me!

name: Luno Express — Swift as Can Be!

nodes.name: 外送皎皎超时开车对话

dialogues.content: Ugh... I really, really don't feel like working today...
The boss and his "brilliant" ideas again. "Bringing Silverpeace flavours to every household," he says. Did he ever stop to think about us poor delivery grunts!?
Need a hand?
Desperately! Ideally, someone to cover my shift — for free. But hey, when does that ever happen?
If you're really up for it, mind carrying a few things for me? I can't pay you, but hey, I'll treat you to all the water you can drink by Lamenting Lake.
Oi! Look what we've got here — someone carrying a feast. Lucky day, boys!
No! These are for customers! If they don't get their food, my whole day's pay goes poof!
Not our problem. Now hand it over.
Back off.
Ugh — what is all this stuff!? Who even leaves this kind of mess in the middle of the road!?
That's it! I quit! I'm going back to tell the boss I'm DONE with this nonsense!
Here. You hold the food. I'll clear the path.
Phew... all delivered. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have earned a single coin today. Okay... break's over. Time to get back to work.
Weren't you just quitting?
(The Lunodeliverer brushes off her coat and walks away. The only answer is a long, weary sigh tossed over her shoulder.)
That's another one down! One more to go... Seriously, can't the boss go five minutes without a "visionary new idea"?
Wait — you cleared it all? We can still make it! GO GO GO!
Whew... thank goodness the soup didn't spill. C'mon, let's finish this delivery before anything else goes wrong...
Oof... Please tell me I didn't just break it...
Who's there!?
Oh... just a passing Phoxhunter. Ahem... Say, how about lending me a hand? Just help me test this thing. It won't bite, promise! I'll even toss you a reward for the trouble.
Just hang in there for 15 seconds — that's all. You've got this!

Wait, every shot missed!? No way... They swore this thing was top-grade Elysian military issue! Ugh, probably just some fancy-looking scrap. Ah — forget what I just said. Here's your payment. And, uh... let's keep this between us, yeah?

Wait, it landed every shot — and you're still standing!? But they swore this thing was top-grade Elysian military issue! Tch. Probably just some overpriced junk... Ah — forget what I just said. Here's your payment. And, uh... let's keep this between us, yeah?
Ugh... why'd the excavator break before it even started working!? Where did I put that toolkit...
Yay, you're a lifesaver! Just stay close and don't let it out of your sight, okay? Be right back~!
Hm... looks like some parts are jammed. If I loosen them a bit, it might make things easier to fix later.
(The excavator's beeping is attracting nearby Filthoids. Better drive them off before they get too close.)
I'm back! Thanks — I knew I could count on you!
Aww... you even unjammed the parts!? You're the best!
Whoa — fancy seeing you here! This has to be fate, right? Say, could you do me a teeny favour and keep an eye on my precious detector while I run back and grab my kit?
Berry, I...

name: One More Check
desc: Ride the lift to the lower level

dialogues.content: Hmm... I wonder if that tweak actually made any difference...
Ah — good timing. I just finished adjusting the lift again. Could you give it a quick ride and tell me if it feels any faster? I've been up and down so many times I honestly can't tell anymore.
Didn't really feel any different.
Yeah... figures. Maybe I'm just tweaking it for peace of mind at this point. Still — appreciate the feedback. Here, something for your time.
It went that fast? Huh... maybe I missed something. Looks like I'll have to do a full diagnostic again. Thanks for helping with the data — here, take this for your trouble.
Ugh... sewer's clogged again...
What's going on?
Whole drain's backed up. My superior tossed me this manual — said to "follow the steps," but I can't make heads or tails of it... Mind lending a hand?
It says here you just need to open three sluice gates to flush it out.
Got it! Mind showing me how it's done? I'll watch and learn.
Nice! Second one's just over there.
And the third... right, there it is!
Done and dusted! Think I've got the hang of it now. Really appreciate it — here, take this for your trouble.

nodes.name: 提前销毁垃圾与npc交付任务

dialogues.content: Nice work! That was a clever approach too. Here — a little something for the help.
Ugh, this pickaxe is useless! Wore out already... What am I supposed to do now — dig with my bare hands?
Hey, you're a Phoxhunter too, right? I took this mining job thinking it'd be easy coin, but there's no way I can finish solo. How about it? We team up, split the reward fifty-fifty?
Brilliant. You tackle those chunks over there, I'll start sorting what I've already pulled out.
Thanks for the help. Here's your cut.
Whoa — that was clever! You've really got a knack for this.
Thanks for the help. Here's your cut.

desc: Search for useful supplies in the strange barrels

dialogues.content: (A few barrels bob along the waterway, some giving off eerie noises. If you open them carefully, you might just find something useful.)

(This barrel is stuffed with rotting household waste, creating revolting gurgling sounds and a nauseating stench. Better try another.)
(Patience pays off. After a meticulous search, you spot a hidden compartment — and inside, a stash of usable supplies.)

(A landslide blocks the path ahead. Clear the rubble to proceed.)

(The noise draws nearby Filthoids. Use the unstable rocks above to your advantage and fight them off.)

desc: Defeat the enemies and disable the alarm

dialogues.content: (Sudden sirens rip through the silence. A swarm of Magnetix Drones surges towards you.)

name: Luno Express — Swift as Can Be!

dialogues.content: Ugh... I really, really don't feel like working today...
Seriously? They want food delivered all the way to Lamenting Lake? Why do people always pick the weirdest places to eat...? Do they care about safety at all? Huff... can't feel my legs...
Need a hand?
YES! I need you to punch those customers — real hard! And chuck a whole blizzard of snowballs at them! Maybe then they'll stop ordering food from the middle of nowhere!

options.content: Got it. Pow! Bam! Consider them punched.

dialogues.content: *sigh* Yeah, yeah, I know. Just let me blow off a little steam, alright? Since I bumped into you — why not tag along for a bit? We can chat while we walk. Might make the trip feel less... ugh. Alright then — let's hit the road.
Ugh, all this ice — if it gets into the food, I'm doomed. There's gotta be a way to clear this mess...

nodes.name: 订餐人和外送皎皎对话

dialogues.content: Phew! Pesky critters all cleared, warm food in hand, lakeside view... Ahhh, this is the life~!
Um... sir, you haven't paid yet...
Huh? Aren't you just a delivery Luno? Why're you still here? Just put it on my tab — I'll pay next time I'm at the restaurant.
But... I can't just go back empty-handed... The boss's gonna yell at me...
(You've seen enough. Without a word, you follow behind. No one notices the snowball quietly forming in your hand...)
Aagh!! What the—!? A snowball!? It's freezing! Aaahhh!! My food — it's in the water! NOOOOO—!!
Help! I don't wanna die on an empty stomach!!
Whoa! What did I just say!? Someone's actually in danger! Quick, let's help him! And hey, if he puts in a good word for me with the boss, maybe I'll finally get a raise... Hehe... hehehehe...
Whoa — that was fast! The dishes are still warm! Let's get them there now before the boss starts his nag-fest again...
(The tunnel is infested with roaming Filthoids. Clear them out.)

What are you doing?

Brilliant! I'll leave the rest to you — my legs are jelly after crawling around all day...
Aaaah! Why are there still live ones!? I'm the researcher here — you're the sample! Not the other way round! Shoo!
Thanks a bunch! That wraps up my samples. Back to the lab I go — see you around!

Thanks — could you handle those ones over there?
That's much better. Appreciate it — here's a little something for your trouble.
(In the distance, the sharp crack of breaking ice echoes through the air. Might be worth checking out.)
Hey, Phoxhunter! I'm in a bit of a pickle — I need some Eclipta Grass for bait, but it's across the lake. Could you fetch some for me?
Great! I'll get the rod ready while you're at it.
*sigh* ...Should've stocked up on bait. Now I can't even make it across to gather more...
Perfect! With this much bait, there's no way I'm going home with an empty bucket!
(The shoreline is crawling with Filthoids. Best clear them out before gathering the Eclipta Grass.)
(You collect all the usable Eclipta Grass nearby. Time to head back to the fisherman.)

desc: Take a picture for the tourist

dialogues.content: Hey there! Would you mind taking a photo for me?
Hello! Would you mind taking a few photos for me? It's my first time in Icelake, and I'd hate to leave without a picture or two.
Thank you so much! Make sure you get that lovely building behind me in the frame — love the design.
These are fantastic! You've got a real eye for this — seriously, thank you!
What are you doing?
Fishing. Shh. Not now.
(You wait quietly beside him. Not a single fish bites.)
Are you sure this is how fishing works?
Silence. Just watch.
All done. Now — your fish?
Already caught it.
(He points at you.)
Not every fish has fins, you know. Sometimes all it takes is a few cryptic words and a strange act or two... And something always bites.
That's what I learned from people. Just try not to nibble so easily next time.
Anyway — sorry for the mischief. Here. Consider this an apology.
The "problem" has been dealt with. Time to check on the strange angler.
Alright, alright! You got me. I've seen how folks fall for a few smooth words and a bit of showmanship... So I figured — why not give it a try myself?
Anyway — sorry for the mischief. Here. Consider this an apology.
All done. Now — your fish?
Already caught it.
(He points at you.)
Not every fish has fins, you know. Sometimes all it takes is a few cryptic words and a strange act or two... And something always bites.

Come, fish. Come.
You don't even have a rod. I don't think chanting's gonna land you anything.
This is a technique I developed after speaking with all sorts of people. The fish I catch? Big. The biggest. You don't believe me? Fine. Catch one yourself. Let's see who's better.
I think I've heard enough. Time to reel the truth out of you.

I smell Eclipta Grass nearby. Its scent is luring my fish away. Clear it out. Then we'll see.

name: Lucky Coins
desc: Ask around about the lucky coins

dialogues.content: Lucky coins! Real magic lucky coins! Come get one while they last!
So? Everyone says they work, don't they?
(As you draw closer, the girl hurriedly fishes a few copper coins from her pocket and holds them out to you.)
Hi there, {性别:Sir|Miss}! Would you like a lucky coin? My mum gave them to me! She said — one coin takes away your worries, two keeps happiness close, and three... three can make any wish come true!
They're really magic! Mum cast a spell on them herself — I swear I'm not lying! If you don't believe me, you can ask around! Go on! I'll be right here waiting.
(You spot a few "lucky coins" lying at the feet of an old man. You walk over to speak with him.)
Lucky coins? Heh... If they really worked, do you think I'd still be starving out here on this street corner?

But don't go repeating that to the little girl, alright? She's got no family left. Poor thing... Sometimes, even when something isn't real, it still gives people something to hold on to. You get what I mean?
(You see a boy turning a few "lucky coins" over in his hands. You walk over to speak with him.)
Can you tell the difference between the lucky coin in my left hand and the plain copper one in my right?
(He holds out both hands. After a careful look... you confirm — they're exactly the same.)
Yup. Because they are both lucky coins. Not made by magic — made by kindness.
Just a few spare coins for a little girl's smile. Honestly? That might be one of the best trades you'll ever find.
Hehe, really? Well, if that's what you want — they're all yours! I hope they bring you lots and lots of happiness!
Earn it on your own, huh...? That's really cool. Do you think... maybe I could do that too, one day?
Of course you could.
Mmm... I'll think about it. Thank you — really!
Which way did they go?
Th—That way... They ran off that way... *sobs* The outer city really is as dangerous as they say...
Help! I've been robbed! Somebody help — please! Anyone!!
Jackpot! Inner city brats are loaded! We're set for months, boys!
Drop what you stole. Now.
Heh — someone's trying to play the hero, huh? Alright then — you asked for it!
(The petty thieves scatter in different directions. You pick the stolen handbag off the ground and weigh your next move.)
(Call it tuition — a lesson in survival. You pocket the money without hesitation. Frankly, it's generous of you not to charge her extra.)
Got it back. Is this the one?
Yes! Yes — that's it! Thank you so, so much!
(She wipes away her tears, then pulls a generous stack of cash from the handbag and presses it into your hands.)
Please — take this. You're such a kind and honest Phoxhunter. Thank you... really... *sobs*
Tch, whatever. Not worth it. Let's bail — move!
(Realising he's no match, the man clutches his box and slinks off without another word.)
Step right up! Big prizes inside — don't miss your chance!
Hey there, Phoxhunter! Care to test your luck? If you can open this box, the prize is all yours!
(You hear a soft click as the lock turns. Just when it seems like you've got it — CLACK! The lid snaps shut. No matter what you try, it refuses to open again.)
Hey! You broke my prize box! You owe me for this! Now gimme your money!

options.content: A box that breaks just from trying it? If it's not rigged, how about I pop that lock out — let the crowd have a proper look.
Last guy who tried to scam me is still recovering in hospital.

dialogues.content: Shhh! Keep it down, will you? I've got other... business opportunities around here. Look — take this, yeah? And let's just pretend this never happened.
Tch! You want trouble!?
(Caught red-handed and knowing better than to argue, the man shoves a pouch of coins into your hand and slinks off with his box.)
Didn't think a two-bit grifter had the guts to fight. But hey — I don't mind doing this the hard way.
You there! Phoxhunter — please, I need your help!
(You deal with the Filthoids swiftly. The tunnels fall silent once more. Time to head back and check on that man.)
(A few metal plates are wedged against the current, scraping and clattering with every shift in water pressure — probably what unsettled the man.)
(You pry them free and tuck them into your pack. Still in decent shape — might fetch a fair price later.)
(Up ahead, a few Filthoids prowl near the upper channel, their guttural growls echoing through the tunnel. This must be the noise that unsettled the man.)
It's quiet now... That scary noise is gone. Thank you so much!
It's quiet now... That scary noise is gone. Thank you so much!
I—I think I heard something up ahead... something awful. Could you go take a look for me? Please?
(You follow the manual's steps and rig the charges in place. Time to set them off and clear the tunnel ahead.)
(You head down the path ahead, but nothing particularly threatening catches your eye. Perhaps it was just in his head.)
(You deal with the Filthoids swiftly. The tunnels fall silent once more. Time to head back and check on that man.)

name: Geniemon Rescue!
desc: Defeat the enemies and rescue the Geniemon

dialogues.content: (The area is swarming with Filthoids. Clear them out to save the Geniemon.)
(The sound of battle draws an indomitable calamity — the avatar of doom descends. Defeat it, just as you have countless times before.)
(The area is secure for now. You've saved the Geniemon!)
Urgh... It's stuck! I can't reel it in...
What's going on?
Oh! A Phoxhunter! Thank the stars — my line's tangled around some junk down there. Mind breaking it loose for me?
Brilliant! I'll hold the line steady — you handle the rest.
Ha! That did it — thanks so much!
Help! Hello? Anyone there? I could really use some help...
Thank you so much... Um, sorry to bother you again, but I sort of left my fishing rod up ahead when I ran. There are still Filthoids around, and I can't get close...
Thanks a ton! I'll wait here, then. Good luck!
That's it! That's my rod! You're a lifesaver — thank you!

name: Rescue the Geniemon!
desc: Defeat the enemies and rescue the Geniemon

dialogues.content: (Lately, Geniemons have become prime targets for poachers. Protect the one before you — and drive them off.)
(More enemies are approaching.)
(The threat has passed. The Geniemon is safe.)
Hey there, Phoxhunter! You're just in time — I've got a once-in-a-lifetime offer you won't want to miss.
So — I stumbled on a stash of Silverite just up ahead, but it was too heavy for me to carry. If you're interested, I can take you there — all yours.
Alright, follow me.
There's more up ahead. Wanna keep going?

options.content: No thanks. I couldn't carry more anyway.

dialogues.content: Alright, come with me.
Tch, so close... Ahem — I mean, your loss! Well, take care out there.
There's more up ahead. Wanna keep going?

options.content: No thanks. I couldn't carry more anyway.

dialogues.content: Alright then — just head on ahead a bit farther. You'll see it.

Here's the first stash.
Here we are.
You run so fast, Daddy! You beat everyone!
Oh! Another challenger! Wanna race my dad? Bet you can't beat him — he's super fast!
Ahem... Alright. But before we start — mind stepping over here for a sec?
Here, take this. Just... go easy on me, yeah? I told my boy that no one could outrun his dad. It was just a small lie to cheer him up...

options.content: Got it. I'll make sure you win.
If we're racing, we're doing it fair and square.

dialogues.content: Thank you... really. I owe you one.
*sigh* I see... Well, I understand.
Alright! It's starting — go, Daddy, go!
Ready...
Set...
Go!
I'm sorry, son... I lost.
That's okay, Daddy! We'll win next time! I believe in you!
Yeah... next time. Thanks for the match, Phoxhunter. Here's your prize — you earned it.
Whoa! You're amazing, Daddy!
Thank you. Here — take this. It's the least I can do.
Hey! That's not what we agreed on...

Yeah... next time. Anyway — thanks for the match. Here's your prize.
Whoa! You're amazing, Daddy!

Sure. Consider it delivered.
Hello — delivery from Silverpeace.
Ugh, look at this mess! Everything's spilled! Silverpeace's delivery service is a joke. How am I supposed to eat this?

options.content: Sorry. I had to fight off some Filthoids on the way. It probably happened during that.

dialogues.content: ...Ah. Then I guess your job's no easier than writing research papers. Sorry I snapped at you. Here — take this for your trouble.

Whoa — easy! If you choke and die, that's on me! Alright, alright... I get it — your job's no easier than writing research papers. Sorry I snapped at you. Here, take this.

Weird day today... Been here all morning, and not even a nibble.

Thank you!
Help! Hello? Anyone there? I could really use some help...

I couldn't have done it without you! Here's a little something for your trouble~ Let's team up again next time!
Why do baddies always show up when I'm in the middle of research? I'm counting on you! I'm just getting to the bottom of it.
That's a wrap! Research successfully complete! Hooray!
Let's see... Hmm... Huh... Almost there! Hang in there!
Ugh... why'd the excavator break before it even started working!? Where did I put that toolkit...
Whoa — fancy seeing you here! This has to be fate, right? Say, could you do me a teeny favour and keep an eye on my precious detector while I run back and grab my kit?
Yay, you're a lifesaver! Just stay close and don't let it out of your sight, okay? Be right back~!
Hm... looks like some parts are jammed. If I loosen them a bit, it might make things easier to fix later.

I'm back! Thanks — I knew I could count on you!

name: Wishen's Unfinished Business
desc: Help the Wishen find the frog

dialogues.content: I want little frogs... want them so much... croak, croak...
Little frogs... I want little frogs... little frogs, little frogs, little frogs...
(It seems strangely fixated on frogs... let's see if we can find some for it.)
These should be enough. Let's take them back to it.
Little frogs! Yay! Little frogs~ Croak, croak...
(And with that, the Wishen faded from sight before your eyes.)

name: Photo at EverSpring
desc: Help the tourist take a photo

dialogues.content: Hey! Could you take a few photos for me?
Hi there, could you take a few photos for me? I don't get to come to EverSpring often, and it'd be a shame to leave without any pictures.
Great! Make sure you get that argent loong behind me as well. I really like the way it looks.
These came out great. You're really good at this — thanks a lot!

name: Class Never Dismisses
desc: Help the teacher keep an eye on the students

dialogues.content: Get this simple question wrong again, and you'll stay behind tonight to copy it out a hundred times.
(An angry voice echoes in the distance. Better go and see what's going on.)
What's going on here?
Hmph... the kid can't even write out the Nine Chapters of Dafeng from memory. With so little self-discipline, how will he ever get anywhere with his studies?
Ugh, I can't take this. The more I think about it, the angrier I get. I'm stepping away for a moment — keep an eye for me, will you?
Thank you. I won't be long.
I've written up to "Let truth be manifest and falsehood driven out," but I just can't recall what comes next. Could you check the notebook for me?
You're a lifesaver! Thank you so much!
Aww... I'm going to get detention... I just want to go out and play...
You've still got it wrong? Tonight, you'll copy it out another five hundred times — and you're not leaving until every last one is done!
Nooo—!
Thank you for helping me. Please, take this as a small token of thanks.

(You open the notebook, filled with copied passages from the statutes of the Nine Chapters of Dafeng. The line after "Let truth be manifest and falsehood driven out" reads: "To deceive and mislead the many — this must not be done.")
Found it. Time to go back.
You're finally back! What's the next line? Quick!
See? Steady your mind and think it through, and the words will come.
Great! I can finally go out and play!
Not so fast! That will do for today — you only need to copy it fifty more times. Finish that, then you can go.
Nooo—!
Thank you for helping me. Please, take this as a small token of thanks.

Thank you for helping me. Please, take this as a small token of thanks.
*sniffle*... I can't remember the next line at all...
Um... could you help me, please...?
Oh no, oh no... this isn't good...
Hey there, I've gone and dropped my wine flask, my bait, and even my rod into the water... Could you catch a few fish for me? If I go back empty-handed again, they'll all laugh at me.
Thank you so much. You're a lifesaver.
How did you even catch something like this...? Could my wine flask have drawn it here? Ah, never mind. I'll figure it out later.
Thanks a ton for catching all these fish. You really saved me today!

Thanks a ton for catching all these fish. You really saved me today!

Thanks a ton for catching all these fish. You really saved me today!
Ugh... why did everything have to land on the same day...
Ah, sorry to bother you, but could you queue up over there and get me a walnut shortbread?
I've got a business meeting coming up, so I really don't have time to stand in a queue.
Cheers. I'll head off, then.
Um... could you sell yours to me? My mum really likes their walnut shortbread, but she's been ill lately... I wanted to take some home for her...
In that case, you should take it. I hope your mum gets better soon.
Sorry, it's for someone else.
Thank you, {性别:Sir|Miss}! You're really kind!
Oh... all right then. Thank you anyway...
Ah, there you are — where is it?

Ah, there you are — where is it?
Here you go.
Mmm, that smells fantastic! Thank you! Here's a little something for your trouble.
(Some time later...)
(Just as you collect the snack, you notice a child behind you gazing at it longingly.)
You're in luck — this is the very last serving of our signature snack. Here you are.

name: Matters of the Heart
desc: Help the man choose the perfect gift

dialogues.content: Oh no... what do I do? Lord Argent, please, send someone to help me!
What's going on?
I'm supposed to meet the girl I love here, but I haven't even finished getting everything ready. Could you make a quick trip to buy a present for me?
Thank you — truly. One more thing: she's allergic to flowers, so whatever you do, don't get anything with flowers in it.
Hello, I'd like to pick out a gift.
All right. These three are our most popular at the moment — let me show them to you.
First, Skylilies freshly picked from Reedshore, still with the morning's dew on them. You can't go wrong giving these to a young lady.
Second, a bronze pendant crafted by a renowned artisan of the Jishu Sect, finely worked with exquisite detail.
Third, a special Lord Argent figurine made by the Xuanheng Sect. The craftsmanship is so fine it looks almost alive.
Which one would you like?
All right, I'll get that wrapped up for you. Do come again.
Here it is! Quick, open it — see if you like it!
Achoo! Ah... ah-choo... Wh—Why would you get me flowers...? I'm feeling awful... I... I can't breathe...
(As soon as he sees her allergy acting up, he lifts her onto his back and dashes off for help, leaving you behind.)
(Everything here is taken care of. You can be on your way.)
Here it is! Quick, open it — see if you like it!
Thank you! I love it. I'd love anything you gave me, honestly.
(Seeing her smile, he slips you a quick thumbs-up.)
(Everything here is taken care of. You can be on your way.)
Here it is! Quick, open it — see if you like it!
Thank you! I love it. I'd love anything you gave me, honestly.
(Seeing her smile, he slips you a quick thumbs-up.)
(Everything here is taken care of. You can be on your way.)

name: Spoilt for Choice
desc: Help the traveller choose an item

dialogues.content: Hmm... which one should I go for...?
Oh — sorry to bother you. I can never decide what to buy. Could I trouble you to take a look and give me a bit of advice?
Thank you so much. I'll wait right here.

Everything I sell is premium stock, brought in directly from its place of origin. Most of it has travelled thousands of miles before reaching my stall, and every item comes with EverSpring's official certification. They may cost a little more, but you really do get what you pay for.
It's all everyday necessities — "premium" doesn't really mean a thing. My goods are much cheaper, and that makes them the better deal. Don't you agree?
Well? Which one do you think is the better buy?

options.content: The Starweaver's goods are better quality — it's the safer choice.
The black marketeer offers the best price — you'll get more for your money with him.

dialogues.content: Right then, I'll go with him! Thanks for the advice!
(After looking everything over, you've made your choice. Time to head back and tell the indecisive traveller what you think.)
(Magistrates of Yingtian incoming! Dispel them!)

name: Get Some Spuds
desc: Drive off the nearby Skywing Gulls

dialogues.content: (As you draw nearer, you find a miserable-looking man slumped on the ground, shreds of potato scattered all around him.)
Sorry to trouble you — but you look like someone dependable. Could you give me a hand?

Thanks — really. Here's the situation: every time I put out so much as a handful of shredded potato, the Skywing Gulls down by the docks absolutely lose their minds and mob the stall. Watch — like this...
Hey— stop! Quit it! If you clear me out, what am I supposed to sell? Someone— anyone— give me a hand!
Ahhhh—! See? See!? They're back again! Please... help me chase them off!
(The Skywing Gulls wheel above you in tight circles, edging closer whenever they think they can snatch a bite— as if their entire existence revolved around shredded potatoes.)
Good thing you chased them off. Hopefully things will stay quiet for a while.
Whew... selling potatoes here is far more dangerous than I thought. Thank you so much...
I didn't expect you to act so decisively. My deepest respects.
Whew... selling potatoes on the docks is far more dangerous than I thought. Thank you so much...

name: Rescue the Geniemon
desc: Defeat the enemies and rescue the Geniemon

dialogues.content: (The area around the Geniemon is swarming with enemies. Defeat them before rescuing it.)
(The sounds of battle have drawn in additional enemies.)
(The area is clear for the moment. Now's your chance to free the Geniemon.)
What's going on today? Been here ages and haven't caught a single fish.
Hey, stranger, I'm starting to think there aren't any fish here at all. Mind giving it a try for me?
Great! Thank you.
Wow, that's incredible. You got one on your first try. Guess it's not the spot after all.
Thanks for helping me check. I'll give it another shot myself. I'm not going home with an empty bucket today, no way!

name: Gold, Silver, and Bronze
desc: Help the girl find her chest

dialogues.content: Yes, this is it! Thank you so much.
This chest is clearly not mine, but thanks anyway.
Whoa — you actually found this many chests? I'll just take my own one, then. Thank you!
Where did it fall...
Excuse me, have you seen a chest I dropped around here? Just a plain chest. I've been looking forever.
Thanks. I'll search around up here. Could you try looking down below?
(No chest in sight. Might as well look somewhere else.)
(No chest in sight. Might as well look somewhere else.)
(No chest in sight. Might as well look somewhere else.)
I picked these up while surveying the river. See if yours is among them?

options.content: I'm looking for this plain chest.
I'm looking for this slightly fancier chest.
I'm looking for this most ornate one.

dialogues.content: Alright, then take it.
Huh, looks like you're looking for something. Is it one of these chests?
Incense... light... please...
Over there... light it... please... thank you...
Burning incense... good...
(After lighting the incense, thick smoke fills the air. Through the haze, you catch glimpses of something...)
(You reach out to touch her, but her form blurs. You know she is nothing more than a vision conjured by the incense.)
(The smoke clears, and everything you saw fades away. Head back and ask the Wishen what that was all about.)
(The smoke clears, and everything you saw fades away. Head back and ask the Wishen what that was all about.)
(The smoke clears, and everything you saw fades away. Head back and ask the Wishen what that was all about.)
Incense burned... farewell...
(In the swirling mist, you see countless treasure chests. Go ahead, open them.)
(In the swirling mist, you see a horde of enemies. Take them down.)
(In the swirling mist, you see a figure — Berry.)
(You reach out to touch her, but her form blurs. You know she is nothing more than a vision conjured by the incense.)
Incense burned... farewell...
Incense burned... farewell...

name: Father's Treasure
desc: Help the child find the treasure

dialogues.content: Help! I haven't found papa's buried treasure yet. I don't wanna die here...
Thanks for saving me! I don't really have anything good to give you... Oh, but I do have a treasure map my papa left. If you find the treasure, it's all yours!

options.content: Judging by the terrain, it should be around here. I'll go take a look.
If your papa left it for you, I can't take it.

dialogues.content: Whoa, you figured it out just like that? Go dig it up!
Oh, that's... that's way too nice of you... Then, um, I'll get you a little something else instead. Thanks again for saving me!
Alright, like I said, the treasure is all yours now. Thanks again for saving me back there.

name: Born Suspicious
desc: Help the shopkeeper investigate the clerk

dialogues.content: (The money is clear proof of their scheme. You can head back now and expose them both, or stick around a little longer and see what else they let slip.)
You there, outsider — yes, I mean you! Could you lend me a hand?
My clerk has been sneaking off to see the shopkeeper next door. Pretty sure he's up to something. Think you could help me dig up some proof?
Good. They're probably around here somewhere. I'll leave it to you — better if I stay out of sight.
Here, take this. And you didn't hear a thing, alright?
Just a quick look at the recipe. What's the harm?
How about a thirty percent cut once it's done? Deal?
Not enough? Then how about— Hang on... you hear something? Come here.
Hah! Just as I thought. Once he gets back, he's out of here.
Alright, forty percent. Just tell me straight, are you in or not? You've been dragging this out for days.
I... I'm sorry. The owner's always looked out for me. I can't do this.
(You manage to stay out of sight and learn what the clerk truly chose. Now head back and tell the shopkeeper the truth.)
So that's how it was. I nearly blamed him for nothing. Thanks.
(Sable Bi'an appear out of nowhere! Drive them off!)
Just one more lap, everyone! Hang in there!
Starweavers definitely need strong legs too! Want to help me keep an eye on them for the last lap?
Great! Just pick one to watch, and let me know when you've decided.
Final sprint! Come on, — no walking now!
So, made up your mind yet?
Got it! I'll keep an eye on the other two!
Having you there really pushed him — he was slow, but he made it all the way to the end! You were a huge help today. Here's a little something from us.
Having you there really pushed him — he ran so fast! You were a huge help today. Here's a little something from us.
Having you there really pushed him — he was slow, but he made it all the way to the end! You were a huge help today. Here's a little something from us.
Having you there really pushed him — he was slow, but he made it all the way to the end! You were a huge help today. Here's a little something from us.

name: Landslide
desc: Clear the rubble blocking the path

dialogues.content: (Collapsed rubble blocks the path ahead. Clear it away.)
(The noise from clearing the rubble has attracted nearby enemies. Drive them off.)
(Plenty of Coralstones grows nearby. You might gather some if you have a moment.)
(You've successfully gathered all the nearby Coralstones. Time to move on.)
(The commotion from gathering the Coralstone has drawn nearby enemies. Drive them off.)
(Though a minor mishap occurred, you've managed to collect all the nearby Coralstones in the end.)
（游荡的敌人挤满了四周，先击退它们，再去解救魔灵吧。）
（争斗的声响引来了更多敌人。）
（附近暂时安全了，趁现在解救魔灵吧。）
喂，那边的朋友，能帮我拍张照吗？
这位朋友，你能帮我拍几张照片吗？难得来一趟百花车站，不留点合影就太可惜了。
太好了，记得把我后面的“铁之心”纪念碑也拍进去哦，我很喜欢它的造型。
你拍得也太好了，真棒呀，多谢多谢。
奇怪……掉哪里了呢？
我的火车票找不到了，它装在一个紫色的小包里，你能帮我一起找找吗？
谢谢你，我在这附近再看看。其他地方就拜托你了。
（没看到紫色小包，再去其他地方找找。）
（没看到紫色小包，再去其他地方找找。）
（没看到紫色小包，再去其他地方找找。）
是来找遗失物的吗？跟我描述一下它的样子吧。

options.content: 紫色的小包，里面有一张火车票。
蓝色的小包，里面有一些铜币。
红色的小包，里面有一张夫妻合照。

dialogues.content: 嗯，确有此物，拿去吧，可别再弄丢了啊。
抱歉，我没找到你说的东西。
就是这个小包，太谢谢你了。
没找到吗……好吧，辛苦你了，我自己再找找看。
（附近都没看到紫色小包，去问问工作人员吧。）
（回去告诉那位旅客吧。）
（回去告诉那位旅客吧。）
怎么勘探器还没干活就坏了，我的修理工具呢……
我们在这种地方都能遇到，太有缘了吧！既然你来了，那要不要帮忙照看下我的宝贝勘探器？
好耶，你就在它边上不要走动哦，我找到工具了就回来！
看起来是有几个零件卡住了，把它们弄开的话应该会更好修一些。
（勘探器的响动将周围的敌人吸引了过来，击退它们吧。）
久等啦！我就知道交给你照看肯定没问题！
诶，你还帮我把卡住的零件掰开了吗，好感动！
Berry, I...
（远处传来木板掉落的声音，过去看看发生了什么吧。）
狩月人？你来得正好，这批建材不小心掉轨道上了，你能帮我一起清理下吗？
感谢帮助，那边几块交给你了。
这样安全隐患就小很多了，拿上吧，这些都是给你的报酬。
